crossRefs.note: My steps have held fast to your paths. My feet have not slipped.
A man’s steps are established by Yahweh. He delights in his way.
Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for Yahweh holds him up with his hand.
For I said, “Don’t let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips.”
Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope.
Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually.
He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.
He will keep the feet of his holy ones, but the wicked will be put to silence in darkness; for no man will prevail by…
“Why wasn’t this ointment sold for three hundred denarii, and given to the poor?”
Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help…
but I prayed for you, that your faith wouldn’t fail. You, when once you have turned again, establish your brothers.”
who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.

translations.web: When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, Yahweh, held me up.
translations.bsb: If I say, “My foot is slipping,” Your loving devotion, O LORD, supports me.
translations.kjv: When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O LORD, held me up.
translations.asv: When I said, My foot slippeth; Thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, held me up.
